description: The conversation on ONE Canton Dev Fund proposal, oldest first: every comment, every formal review (approved, changes requested, commented) and every inline review comment on the proposal file, with author, GitHub role (member, collaborator, none), date, and the text. Pages with offset. Use to read what reviewers, champions and the committee actually said, or why a proposal stalled. Canton-specific.

kind.description: Only this kind: issue_comment (conversation), review_comment (inline on the file), review (a formal review verdict).

limit.description: How many entries to return. Default 10, max 30. The response states the full count.

offset.description: Skip this many entries, for paging.

name: get_proposal_discussion
